title: STOP FRAUD in Medicaid Act
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.
summary:
States Taking On Power For Redressing All Unlawful Deceits in Medicaid Act or the STOP FRAUD in Medicaid Act

This bill expands the scope of state Medicaid fraud control units to include investigating and prosecuting fraud in connection with the activities of individuals who apply for or receive Medicaid benefits. Currently, these units investigate and prosecute fraud in relation to Medicaid providers.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.
